blocks.text: Effectors jism ke woh hisse hain jo control centre ka paigham milne par jawab (response) dete hain. Muscles aur glands effectors ka kaam karte hain. Muscles sukar kar (contract ho kar) jawab dete hain aur glands apna ras (secretion) nikalte hain. Is tarah effectors ka jawab andar ke mahol ko wapas set point par le aata hai. Maslan jab jism ka darja-e-hararat set point se neeche girta hai to jild aur muscles ke effectors kaampna (shivering) aur jild ki khoon ki nalyon ka sukarna (vasoconstriction) shuru kar dete hain. Is se hararat (heat) zyada banti hai aur darja-e-hararat wapas set point tak barh jata hai.

blocks.alt: Ghari ki sui ki simt (clockwise) chalta chakkar. Andaruni mahol ki halat mein tabdeeli se see-saw ka 'Imbalance' takhta jhuk jata hai; seedhe takhte par 'Internal conditions (in homeostasis)' likha hai. Tabdeeli receptor pakarta hai, maloomat control centre ko jati hai, control centre effector ko paigham bhejta hai, aur effector ka jawab halat ko wapas maamool par le aata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.1: Homeostasis ke ajza (elements) (kitab ki Figure 13.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Receptor (neela dabba, baayen), control centre (gulabi, upar) aur effector (hara, daayen) chakkar par hain. Teeron par likha hai: 'Change detected by receptor', 'Information sent to control centre', 'Message sent to Effector' aur 'Response of effector to return the condition to normal'. Neeche see-saw par seedha takhta 'Internal conditions (in homeostasis)' aur tircha takhta hai jis ke dono siron par 'Imbalance' likha hai; uthe hue sire ke neeche chhota teer 'Change in internal environmental condition' dikhata hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: See-saw ko dekhein: seedha takhta set point par mutawazin (balanced) andaruni halat hai. Jab koi tabdeeli aati hai, maslan darja-e-hararat barhna, to tircha 'Imbalance' takhta ek taraf utha hua dikhta hai. Wahan se teer receptor ki taraf jata hai: receptor tabdeeli pakarta, control centre faisla karta, effector jawab deta, aur aakhri teer wapas seedhe takhte par aata hai, yaani halat phir maamool par aa gayi. Har homeostasis mein yahi chakkar chalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Thand ke din kaampte waqt receptor, control centre aur effector kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Receptors: jild aur hypothalamus ke darja-e-hararat ke receptors; control centre: hypothalamus; effectors: kaampne wale skeletal muscles (aur sukarne wali jild ki nalyan).

items: Receptors tabdeeli pakarte hain aur control centre ko khabar dete hain.
Control centre (dimagh, spinal cord, endocrine glands) faisla kar ke effectors ko paigham bhejta hai.
Effectors (muscles aur glands) jawab de kar halat ko set point par wapas laate hain.
